title: Neural differential equations tutorial at KSC 2026
text: YongKyung Oh will present A Practical Guide to Neural Differential Equations. The conference program also lists his talk on learning reliable dynamics from imperfect observations and a presentation on DualDynamics.

title: YongKyung Oh to receive the Wooheon early-career researcher award
text: The Korean Institute of Industrial Engineers (KIIE) will present the award.

title: OpenAI approves ChatGPT research access for YongKyung Oh
text: YongKyung Oh was approved for 12 months of individual access through ChatGPT for Academic Researchers.

title: KISTI awards HANGANG computing time to a Pusan National University project
text: KISTI selected a project led by YongKyung Oh at Pusan National University for the Exploratory Research track of its R&D Innovation Program. The allocation runs from December 2026 through March 2027.

title: Google TPU Research Cloud provides computing support
text: Google’s TPU Research Cloud confirmed 180 days of in-kind access to Cloud TPUs for the lab, with YongKyung Oh as principal investigator.

title: U.S. patent granted for time-series image encoding
text: A U.S. patent on encoding time-series data as images, co-invented by the lab’s PI, was issued to UNIST (US 12,725,326 B2).

title: Scientific Inference Lab opens
text: The Scientific Inference Lab opens at Pusan National University.

title: Silent failures at KDD 2026
text: The paper on silent failures in federated personalization appears in the KDD 2026 proceedings, Blue Sky Ideas Track.

title: Evidence standards at ICML 2026
text: A sole-authored position paper on evidence standards for machine learning was presented at ICML 2026.

title: UCLA project selected for the NVIDIA Academic Grant Program
text: NVIDIA selected UCLA’s Neural SDE-Augmented GPU-Accelerated Pharmacokinetic Simulation Framework project. Alex A. T. Bui is the principal investigator and YongKyung Oh is a lead scientist on the project team.

title: FlowPath in the AAAI 2026 proceedings
text: FlowPath, a method for classifying irregularly sampled time series, was published in the AAAI 2026 proceedings.

title: FlowPath and Continuum Dropout at AAAI 2026
text: The AAAI 2026 poster program in Singapore listed FlowPath and Continuum Dropout for Neural Differential Equations.

title: Neural differential equations tutorial at CIKM 2025
text: YongKyung Oh, Dong-Young Lim, and Sungil Kim gave a tutorial on modeling irregular time series with neural differential equations, including exercises on interpolation and classification.

title: Best Paper Award at CHIL 2025
text: YongKyung Oh and Alex Bui’s paper on adapting medical time-series models across domains received the Best Paper Award in the Models and Methods Track at CHIL 2025.
